requirements.reason: The official Node.js SLSA builder is deprecated and requires a movable major/minor tag reference, conflicting with the repository SHA-pinning policy.
requirements.next_step: Move release assembly to an independently operated trusted builder or a hermetic dedicated builder with an immutable policy.

requirements.reason: GitHub OIDC signs provenance outside user-controlled signing code.
Hosted ephemeral runners and read-only build permissions are present, but the build can access the network and runs user-defined workflow steps.
A signed VSA is generated by the project's own verifier workflow; it is not an independent third-party verifier.

claim_rule: Never emit SLSA_BUILD_LEVEL_3 in a VSA until trusted-builder and build-isolation are satisfied.
